vector_memory.semantic_summary: This component provides a foundational utility for syntactic analysis by defining an abstract interface for parsing source code into an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST). It includes a concrete implementation, PythonASTParser, which leverages Python's built-in 'ast' module. Its core functions involve parsing raw code strings into AST objects and recursively converting these complex AST structures into serializable dictionary formats for knowledge graph ingestion.
